children: Dell Technologies Inc. reported results for the quarter ended 2026 with revenue of $46.97B and diluted EPS of $6.34, driven by strong demand for AI-optimized servers and continued strength in commercial PC refresh and storage.
¹ Reported as “Total net revenue”. ² Reported as “Net income”. ³ Reported as “Diluted earnings per share”.
Revenue growth was led by the Infrastructure Solutions Group (ISG), with substantial demand for AI-optimized servers (ISG-led net revenue up sharply year over year: Q2 +89%, six months +124%).
Business mix shifted toward ISG products while VMware resale revenue declined following the termination of the distributor agreement.
Commercial PC refresh and increased storage adoption supported Client Solutions Group (CSG) and ISG growth respectively.
Operationally, the company increased inventory and purchase commitments to address an AI server backlog and scaled DFS financing originations to support demand.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.
